design_decisions.title: Discrete MOSFET H-bridge
design_decisions.rationale: User requested non-integrated solution using industrial bridge topology. P+N MOSFET pairs with IR2104 gate drivers for each half-bridge.
design_decisions.impact: Increased component count (8 MOSFETs + 4 gate drivers) but full control over switching characteristics.

design_decisions.title: 12V motor supply via USB-C PD
design_decisions.rationale: USB-C can deliver 5V default; 12V motor rail derived from USB VBUS.  For higher voltages an external supply would be needed.
design_decisions.impact: Motor voltage limited to 5V with standard USB-C. Components rated for 12V for future upgrade path.

design_decisions.title: Modbus RTU over RS-485
design_decisions.rationale: Industrial standard for multi-drop serial control. Single UART with DE pin for half-duplex.
design_decisions.impact: Adds RS-485 transceiver and termination/bias resistors.

risks: Bootstrap gate drive may fail at very low PWM duty cycles (< 5%)
IR2104S minimum VCC is 10V - need level shifting for 5V operation
GD32F130C8T6 pin compatibility with STM32F103 not guaranteed - verify pinout
